name: av_lim_atol_zero
source:
{ atol = 0: the weight becomes purely relative, so a state passing through zero
  makes the weight vanish. }
DYNAMIC atol0 (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 4, points = 9, rtol = 1e-6, atol = 0)
  der(Yv) = cos(time)
  Yv(0) = 0
END
